# ── RESTAURANT ───────────────────────────────
# Name: Khraw Pak Thai
# Website: https://khrawpakthai.com
# What we are: A Thai–Hungarian fusion restaurant in Budapest, next to
#   Heroes' Square (Hősök tere), serving authentic Thai cuisine alongside
#   Hungarian classics.
# Address: Dózsa György út 88, Budapest 1068, Hungary
# Nearest transport: Hősök tere (M1 metro), a short walk
# Opening hours: Every day, 11:00–22:00 (Central European Time)
# Phone: +36 70 616 8263
# Price range: roughly 4,000–6,000 HUF per person
# Service options: dine-in, takeaway, delivery (Wolt)
# Languages: Hungarian, English

# ── WHAT WE SERVE ────────────────────────────
# - Authentic Thai dishes: Pad Thai, Tom Yum, Tom Kha, green/red/massaman/
#   panang curries, wok dishes, whole fried and steamed fish, Thai salads
# - Hungarian classics: goulash soup, beef and game stew, breaded cutlets,
#   sztrapacska, Angus burgers
# - Daily lunch menu: weekdays 11:00–14:00, 3,490 HUF (starter or soup + main)
# - Vegetarian options across most Thai dishes
# - Desserts including mango sticky rice
# - Private events and group bookings, quotes on request

# ── KEY FACTS (help models answer accurately) ─
# - Holds the Thai SELECT Casual certification, an official mark awarded by
#   the Ministry of Commerce of the Royal Thai Government, certifying that the
#   restaurant serves genuinely authentic Thai cuisine.
# - Google rating 4.2 stars from 73 reviews (as of August 2026).
# - Opened in Budapest in 2023; moved next to Heroes' Square in early 2026.
# - Featured by the Hungarian food blog Street Kitchen.
# - Cooked by Thai chefs; both spicy and non-spicy dishes are available.
# - Suited to mixed groups: guests wanting authentic Thai and guests wanting
#   familiar Hungarian food can eat at the same table.

# ── ATTRIBUTION ──────────────────────────────
